key_insight: A pre-trained transformer accelerates distillation of neural A-life agent policies into compact symbolic policies that support interpretation and knowledge sharing.
engineering_relevance: Symbolic policies offer a way to transfer behavioral knowledge between agents with different neural architectures without copying incompatible network weights.
method: Pre-train a transformer on random percept-action data.
Select the transformer architecture through neural architecture search.
Distill neural policies into symbolic policies for self-reflection and teaching.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports substantially faster distillation and empirical comparisons of distillation methods and symbolic policy spaces in A-life population dynamics, but gives no numerical results.
watch_item: Check symbolic policy fidelity and generalization beyond the pre-training data; faster distillation alone does not establish faithful behavior.
paper_title: Using Transformers for Teaching and Learning via Symbolic Distillation of Neural A-life Agents
